newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Italy's Ciampi says EMU delay not discussed.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi says EMU delay not discussed.

text.p: Italian Treasury and Budget Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Monday that a meeting of his EU counterparts had not discussed a controlled delay to the the planned European single currency.

Ciampi told a news conference that EU economic and finance ministers had showed "particular appreciation" for Italy's progress on controlling inflation and saw the country's economic fundamentals as good.
Ministers also stressed the importance of his country's commitment to the stability criteria required for European economic and monetary union, he said.
He said the progress of the economy would be monitored on an annual basis and if needed, measures would be taken to bring it back into line.
Ciampi added that he saw a 1.2 percent GDP growth rate in 1997 as remaining a possibility for his country.
